name: Happy Lucky Crazy
original_name: ハッピーラッキークレイジー
source:
The main character, Yasushi Onodera, was morbidly obsessed with being an honor student.
However, he felt stressed and was bullying his cousin Kyosuke Shiraishi in the shadow to resolve his dissatisfaction.

[Taken from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/3378]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
主角小野寺倭对成为优等生有着近乎病态的执着。

然而，这也让他承受着压力。为了发泄心中的不满，他在暗地里欺凌自己的表亲白石恭介。

[摘自[url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/3378]NovelGame[/url]]
